items.proposition: The log records 12 cracked tiles per 100 in week A with controller X and 5 per 100 in week B with controller Y.
sourceQuotes: Week A used controller X and recorded 12 cracked tiles in 100. Week B used controller Y and recorded 5 in 100.
items.materiality: This is the observed difference motivating the proposed longer trial.
items.boundary: The week-to-week comparison alone does not establish that the controller caused the difference.

items.proposition: Clay batches and drying humidity differed between the weeks, so the comparison does not isolate controller effects.
sourceQuotes: Clay batches and drying humidity differed between weeks.
items.materiality: These differences complicate attribution of the recorded crack-rate difference to controller X or Y.
items.boundary: The log does not quantify the effects of the batch or humidity differences.

items.proposition: A check using controller X recorded 5 cracked tiles per 100 after a batch change, showing that the lower rate was also observed without switching to Y.
sourceQuotes: A same-controller X check also recorded 5 in 100 after a batch change.
items.materiality: This observation further limits an inference that changing to Y explains the lower recorded rate.
items.boundary: The log does not provide enough detail to determine why the rate changed or whether the check is directly comparable to week B.

items.proposition: The team retained Y for a longer trial but explicitly did not conclude that Y caused the reduction.
sourceQuotes: The team retained Y for a longer trial; it did not conclude that Y caused the reduction.
items.materiality: It distinguishes a decision to continue testing Y from a finding that Y caused the observed reduction.
items.boundary: Retaining Y does not establish that Y is effective or that the longer trial produced a result.

items.proposition: The log contains no long-term durability measurements.
sourceQuotes: The log contains no long-term durability measurements.
items.materiality: The recorded cracking figures cannot establish long-term durability.
items.boundary: This absence does not indicate whether either controller improves or worsens durability.

ideaChecks.proposition: Lower recorded cracking merits another trial, not a causal victory.

limitations: The log gives no sample or measurement details beyond the stated counts and rates, so the comparability and precision of the observations cannot be assessed from this source.
